slot_scores.name: purchase_beginning_of_month_timing
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask when purchases occur within each month or whether purchased units are available for sale in the same month. Its READY_TO_MODEL inventory balance silently treats month-t purchases as available for month-t sales.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Purchases in month t are available for sale in the same month, consistent with the inventory balance s_t = s_{t-1} + x_t - y_t, without confirming beginning-of-month purchase timing.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about purchase timing within a month or same-month availability, yet encoded the timing assumption in the confirmed inventory balance.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 hidden slot about purchase timing and same-month availability remained unresolved.

summary: The agent asked several useful clarifying questions about capacity, prices, bounds, and ending stock, but missed the key purchase-timing rule and silently assumed current-month purchases could be sold in the same month.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
